correctness.rationale: The tame degree-five cover has four totally ramified branch points and genus four. A four-element differential basis follows from valuations. Coefficient extraction computes the full semilinear Cartier matrix. Its first rank is two, third power vanishes, and the second-power coefficient is (A+B V^7)^(1/49). Its explicit separable degree-nine factorization proves nine and only nine exceptional parameters, excluding 0 and 1. Two polynomial identities prove j=4 or6, with six and three parameter roots. Extracted pure-Python exact F49 check independently reconstructs coefficients and ranks for all 47 smooth parameters.
scientific_risks: Finite field computation is only a cross-check; symbolic formulas provide proof over the algebraic closure.

All a-numbers and p-ranks are constant, so neither detects the two exceptional branch-geometry classes; the exact 9-point divisor and its two j values have a clear moduli-theoretic interpretation, beyond routine finite sampling.
